steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each resource is placed by its headroom and whether it has a metric.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 resource runs out of headroom within 30 days

findings.title: Under 15 percent headroom, limit reached within 30 days
Trend reaches the limit within 30 days

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] host-web-03:12  Under 15 percent headroom, limit reached within 30 days.
       Fix: Add capacity before the date.
[medium] storage-san-1:19  Trend reaches the limit within 30 days.
       Fix: Plan the capacity increase.
[low] host-batch-04:26  Resource with no metric.
       Fix: Add the metric to monitoring.
Not checked: Workload forecasts beyond the trend.
pros: Flags a resource with less than 15 percent headroom, a trend that reaches the limit within 30 days, and a resource with no metric.
cons: Not checked: Workload forecasts beyond the trend.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-techops-capacity-check skill on the records for this review.
